BombVault 7.0.0 is a milestone that closes out the entire 6.x line. It adds six new capabilities in one wave and folds every 6.x release into this single page — every 6.x tag and Docker image stays available.

## New in 7.0.0

- **Missed backups catch up automatically.** A home server that is off at night silently skips its scheduled backups, and the protection status slowly goes stale. On start (about two minutes after boot, so the array and Docker are up), BombVault now checks every enabled domain: if the most recent scheduled run was missed, that backup runs right away instead of waiting a full cycle. It is a completely normal run, visible in the activity log with a "catching up" line in the server log. Enabled by default; toggle under Settings → Schedules → Missed schedules. Domains that have never run are deliberately left alone.
- **Overdue-backup watchdog.** Until now an overdue backup was only visible if you looked at the dashboard. A lightweight daily check now sends a notification through your existing channels when a domain's last successful backup is older than twice its schedule period, the exact same rule the dashboard uses. One message per incident, not daily spam: it re-arms only after a successful backup. Enabled by default; toggle under Settings → Notifications → Overdue backup watchdog.
- **Storage forecast.** Each domain row on the Storage card now shows a compact forecast under its size history: weekly growth, free space on the repository volume, and, while growth continues, a projection like "Repo volume full in ~6 weeks", highlighted once it drops under eight weeks. Nothing shows until enough history exists to be honest about it.
- **Heatmap drilldown.** Click any day in the backup heatmap to see exactly what happened: the activity log scrolls into view filtered to that day, marked with a clearable chip. Clicking the active day again (or the chip's ×) clears the filter. Cells are keyboard-accessible.
- **Exclusion assistant.** A container's appdata often carries gigabytes that are pointless to back up, such as browser caches, transcode folders, or node_modules. Next to each container's exclude list, the new assistant scans the appdata for well-known cache folders and any unusually large directory (over 200 MB), shows each with its size and reason, and one click adds it to the excludes, which flow straight into the backup as before. Already-excluded folders are skipped; the scan is depth- and time-bounded.
- **Apprise notifications.** Point BombVault at your Apprise API container's `/notify/<key>` endpoint (Settings → Notifications → Apprise) and reach the 100+ services Apprise supports: Telegram, Pushover, Signal, PagerDuty and friends. The channel behaves exactly like the built-in ones, including the test button, the scheduled-run summary and the weekly digest.

## The 6.x line, folded in

Everything below shipped across the 6.x releases and remains in this build. The individual 6.x release entries are consolidated here; their tags and Docker images stay published.

- **6.0.0** — Files backup domain (named host-folder sets with full domain parity), restore from another BombVault repository, off-site verification badge on the protection cards.
- **6.1.0** — Selective (partial) restore for file sets; aligned Protection Status card.
- **6.2.0** — Identity-stable retention: path changes no longer freeze pruning of an item's older snapshots; retention failures now notify.
- **6.3.0** — Verify self-heals stale repository locks; "What's new" retries instead of failing; the web UI moved to the current front-end generation.
- **6.4.0** — "Replicate now" runs in the background (no more 504s on long copies); the off-site connection test gives each attempt its own time budget.
- **6.5.0** — Repository-lock collisions removed at the source; a hung restic is reaped without a container restart; a stable container hostname for restic locks.
- **6.6.0** — Live activity log on the dashboard; clearer wording for scheduled backups and post-backup updates.
- **6.7.0** — Scheduled runs replicate once per domain instead of once per container (a ~22-hour queue finishes in minutes); persistent restic cache; starvation-free ordering; failed update checks become visible; the Errors tile clears again; compact VM snapshot lists.
- **6.8.0** — The activity log shows everything (replication, prunes, drills, tamper tests, exports); weekly digest; update-check visibility; a restic cache size limit; the "Files" domain renamed to "Folders" everywhere.
- **6.8.1** — Private container registries for post-backup updates; dates in the activity log; light mode readable everywhere.
- **6.8.2** — Raw cron expressions as a schedule type; log dates follow your region, not the UI language.
- **6.8.3 – 6.8.5** — The activity log records live drill, tamper and export runs; restore errors carry their real causes; tamper-schedule clarity for non-immutable off-site repos.
- **6.9.0** — Embeddable, iframe-ready activity-log widget page (token-protected).
- **6.10.0** — Native Unraid dashboard tile with one-click install (the bombvault-widget companion plugin) and a borderless visual language across the whole app.

## Upgrading

Nothing to do: settings, schedules and repositories carry over untouched. This is a milestone number, not a breaking change.
